test_title: PYST 29: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Town N is to the north of Town M. Town O is to the east of Town N. Town P is to the north of Town O. Town Q is to the east of Town P. Town R is to the east of Town Q. What is the position of Town R with respect to Town M?
solution:
• Town N is to the north of Town M.
 
• Town O is to the east of Town N.
 
• Town P is to the north of Town O.
 
• Town Q is to the east of Town P.
 
• Town R is to the east of Town Q
